links.outcome: GPT accuracy on surgical MCQs versus full MedMCQA benchmark
links.effect: GPT-3.5 53.3% and GPT-4 64.4% on surgical questions; GPT-4 performed worse on surgical questions than on the whole dataset, GPT-3.5 the opposite.
links.quote: When compared to their performance on the full MedMCQA dataset, the two models performed differently: GPT-4 performed worse on surgical questions than on the dataset as a whole, while GPT-3.5 showed the opposite pattern.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 on surgical multiple-choice questions from the MedMCQA benchmark to measure baseline accuracy across specialties without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
